data.name: AppStartFailed
data.value: The app could not start. Close it and open it again.

data.name: AppUnexpectedError
data.value: Something went wrong, so the last action may not have finished. Try it again; if it keeps failing, restart the app.

data.name: CreateIdentityUseTor
data.value: Use Tor for the internet route

data.name: CreateIdentityUseTorHint
data.value: Others on the same network can see that a device uses Tor. You can turn it off or on later on the contact list.

data.name: CreateIdentityIntro
data.value: Choose the name your contacts will see. The app creates your keys on this device. No phone number, email or account is needed.

data.name: CreateIdentityInvalidName
data.value: Enter a name of up to 64 bytes (fewer letters in some alphabets) without control characters.

data.name: CreateIdentityAlreadyCreated
data.value: This device already has an identity.

data.name: CreateIdentityFailed
data.value: The identity could not be created. Try again.

data.name: ContactListEmpty
data.value: No contacts yet. Meet them and add each other in person, or add the code they sent you and send them yours.

data.name: ContactListNoNetwork
data.value: This device has no Wi-Fi and no internet. Nearby contacts can be reached if one person shares a hotspot from a phone and the others join it.

data.name: ContactListTorOff
data.value: Internet route off: Tor is turned off on this device. Nearby messaging continues.

data.name: ContactListTorStartingFormat
data.value: Connecting to Tor ({0} %). Nearby messaging works meanwhile.

data.name: ContactListTorNotInBuild
data.value: Internet route unavailable: Tor is not part of this build. Nearby messaging continues.

data.name: ContactListTorNoNetwork
data.value: Internet route unavailable: this device has no network connection. Nearby messaging continues.

data.name: ContactListTorClockWrong
data.value: Internet route unavailable: the date or time on this device is wrong, so Tor cannot connect. Set the correct date and time; nearby messaging continues.

data.name: ContactListTorCannotReach
data.value: Internet route unavailable: the app cannot reach the Tor network. Tor may be blocked here, or the internet does not work. Nearby messaging continues.

data.name: ContactListTorFailed
data.value: Internet route unavailable: Tor could not start on this device. The app tries again shortly; nearby messaging continues.

data.name: ContactListTorStopped
data.value: Internet route unavailable: Tor stopped. The app starts it again shortly; nearby messaging continues.

data.name: ContactAddedNoticeFormat
data.value: {0} is added. The app checked their key, not who they are.

data.name: ProfileCodeHelp
data.value: Send this code to your contacts through another messenger, or save it as a file and pass it on. It holds your public keys and your name, never your private key. Anyone who reads it learns your public keys, so send it only to the people you want to add you.

data.name: ProfileCopyFailed
data.value: The code could not be copied.

data.name: ProfileSaveFailed
data.value: The file could not be saved.

data.name: AddContactIntro
data.value: Paste the code your contact sent you, or open their code file or QR image. They must add your code too.

data.name: AddContactFileTooLarge
data.value: This file is too large to be a contact code.

data.name: AddContactFileUnreadable
data.value: The file could not be read.

data.name: AddContactNotACode
data.value: This is not a P2PMessenger contact code.

data.name: AddContactUnsupportedVersion
data.value: This code comes from another version of the app and cannot be read.

data.name: AddContactDamaged
data.value: This code is damaged. Ask for it again.

data.name: AddContactKeysInUse
data.value: This code holds keys that belong to you or to another contact, so it cannot be added.

data.name: AddContactNewHint
data.value: The app will ask you both to compare fingerprints, because a code sent as text, a file or an image can be swapped on the way.

data.name: AddContactNewKeysFormat
data.value: {0} is already a contact, and this code has new connection keys for them. It is signed with the same identity key, so the fingerprint is the same. Accept the new keys only if {0} expects it.

data.name: AddContactLooksLikeFormat
data.value: A saved contact is called {0}, but this code has a different key. If it really comes from {0}, they now have a new identity, for example after reinstalling the app. You can add it as a new contact and compare fingerprints with them.

data.name: AddContactStale
data.value: Your contacts changed meanwhile. Check the code again.

data.name: ConversationWaitingFormat
data.value: Waiting for the first connection with {0}. They become a contact when their app proves that it holds the key in their code. They must add your code too, and both devices must be on the same network or both connected to Tor.

data.name: ConversationKeyNotComparedFormat
data.value: You have not compared keys with {0}. Their code came as text, a file or an image, which can be swapped on the way.

data.name: ConversationNotAddedFormat
data.value: Not sent: {0} becomes a contact only after the first connection.

data.name: ConversationTooLong
data.value: Not sent: the message is too long.

data.name: ConversationNotSendable
data.value: Not sent: the message contains characters that cannot be sent.

data.name: ConversationNotAContact
data.value: Not sent: this person is not a contact.

data.name: DeliveryWaitingExplanation
data.value: The contact's app has not confirmed this message yet; it is sent again automatically until it does, and it may already have arrived.

data.name: DeliveryReceivedExplanation
data.value: The contact's app confirmed that it has stored this message; this does not show whether they have read it.

data.name: VerifyIntroFormat
data.value: Compare these numbers with {0}, in person or on a call. Both apps show the same two numbers in the same order.

data.name: VerifyCheckedFormat
data.value: Key checked by you. The key matches the one {0} showed you; this does not prove who they are.

data.name: VerifyNotComparedFormat
data.value: Key not compared. Compare the numbers with {0} before you trust this contact.

data.name: VerifyMismatch
data.value: Do not trust this contact. Their code may have been swapped on the way. Exchange codes again, in person if you can.

data.name: NetworkIntro
data.value: Debug builds only. What this device sees of the local network: its local interfaces, its ports and where each contact was last heard.

data.name: NetworkTorFormat
data.value: Tor: {0}, {1} %, problem: {2}, onion service published: {3}, onion target: {4}.

data.name: NetworkDiscoveryFormat
data.value: This device announces itself and listens for contacts on UDP port {0}.

data.name: NetworkDiscoveryUnavailableFormat
data.value: UDP port {0} is used by another program: this device announces itself but hears no one.

data.name: NetworkDiscoveryOff
data.value: This device does not look for contacts.

data.name: NetworkTorNotUsed
data.value: Over Tor: not tried, because the internet route is not available.

data.name: NetworkTorNotFound
data.value: Over Tor: their onion service was not found. Their app may not be connected to Tor.

data.name: NetworkTorNoAnswer
data.value: Over Tor: their onion service did not answer.

data.name: NetworkTorTimedOut
data.value: Over Tor: the last attempt timed out.

data.name: NetworkTorRefused
data.value: Over Tor: their app did not accept the connection.

data.name: NetworkTorFailed
data.value: Over Tor: the last attempt failed.

data.name: DialUnreachable
DialTimedOut
DialRefused
StorageKeyStoreUnavailable
data.value: Your stored data is protected by this device's key store, which the app cannot reach now. On Linux the key store is a Secret Service such as GNOME Keyring or KWallet. Start it, then try again.

data.name: StorageKeyStoreRefused
data.value: The key store did not give the app the key that protects your stored data. Unlock the key store when it asks (on Linux, often the login keyring), then try again.

data.name: StorageKeyNotFound
data.value: The key that protects this data is not in this device's key store, so the data cannot be read here. It may have been copied from another device or user account, or its key was removed from the key store.

data.name: StorageNewerVersion
data.value: This data was saved by a newer version of the app. Use that version or a newer one.

data.name: StorageDamaged
data.value: The stored data was changed or damaged, so the app cannot read it.

data.name: StorageMemoryOnly
data.value: Nothing is saved on this device, because no passphrase was set and the app has no key store here to protect stored data. Your identity, contacts and messages stay in memory and are lost when the app closes.

data.name: CreateIdentityNoPassphraseWarning
data.value: Without a passphrase, anyone who can unlock this device can open the app and read your chats.

data.name: CreateIdentityNoPassphraseNoKeyStore
data.value: Without a passphrase, nothing is saved on this device: your identity, contacts and messages are lost when the app closes.

data.name: CreateIdentityPassphraseRequired
data.value: No key store answered on this device, so the app can save your data only under a passphrase. Enter one above, or start the key store (on Linux, a Secret Service such as GNOME Keyring) and try again.

data.name: UnlockStartIntro
data.value: Your stored data is protected by a passphrase. Until you enter it, the app neither sends nor receives messages.

data.name: UnlockLockedIntro
data.value: The app is locked. Messages still arrive and are saved while it is locked.

data.name: UnlockFailed
data.value: The passphrase could not be checked. Try again.

data.name: PassphraseStateSetFormat
data.value: Your stored data is protected by a passphrase. The app asks for it at start and after {0} minutes in the background.

data.name: PassphraseStateNotSet
data.value: Your stored data is protected by this device's key store, not by a passphrase. Anyone who can unlock this device can open the app.

data.name: PassphraseHintFormat
data.value: At least {0} characters. A few words are easier to remember than a short password.

data.name: PassphraseTooShortFormat
data.value: The passphrase needs at least {0} characters.

data.name: PassphraseNotText
data.value: The passphrase contains characters that cannot be used.

data.name: PassphraseMismatch
data.value: The two passphrases are not the same.

data.name: PassphraseRemoveWarning
data.value: After the passphrase is removed, this device's key store protects the data, and anyone who can unlock this device can open the app.

data.name: PassphraseChangeNote
data.value: Changing the passphrase does not change the key that encrypts your data: anyone who could open an earlier copy of the app's files with the old passphrase can open later copies too.

data.name: PassphraseKeyStoreFailed
data.value: This device's key store did not answer or refused, so nothing was changed. Start or unlock the key store when it asks, then try again.

data.name: PassphraseFailed
data.value: The passphrase could not be changed. Try again.

data.name: PassphraseForgotten
data.value: A forgotten passphrase cannot be recovered or reset, and neither can the data it protects.

data.name: DeleteAllDataIntroUnlock
data.value: If the passphrase is forgotten, the only way to use the app again is to delete all its data on this device and create a new identity.

data.name: DeleteAllDataIntroProblem
data.value: If the stored data cannot be opened, you can delete it from this device and create a new identity.

data.name: DeleteAllDataWarning
data.value: This deletes your identity, your contacts and all chats from this device, and it cannot be undone. Messages that are still waiting will not be sent. Your contacts' apps keep their copies of your chats.

data.name: DeleteAllDataFailed
data.value: The data could not be deleted. Try again.

data.name: DeleteAllDataDone
data.value: All data was deleted from this device. Your contacts' apps keep their copies of your chats.

data.name: DeleteAllDataIncomplete
data.value: Not every file could be deleted. Close any other copy of the app and delete all data again.

data.name: ConversationDeleteChatQuestionFormat
data.value: Delete the chat with {0}? Its messages are removed from this device, and messages that are still waiting will not be sent. {0}'s app keeps its copy.

data.name: ConversationChatDeletedFormat
data.value: The chat was deleted on this device only. {0}'s app still has its copy.

data.name: ConversationDeleteChatFailed
data.value: The chat could not be deleted. Try again.

data.name: MessageDeleteQuestion
data.value: Delete this waiting message? It will not be sent again.

data.name: ConversationMessageDeletedFormat
data.value: The waiting message was deleted on this device and will not be sent again. If it reached {0}'s app before its confirmation came back, it stays there.

data.name: ConversationMessageNotWaiting
data.value: The message is no longer waiting, so it was not deleted.

data.name: ConversationMessageDeleteFailed
data.value: The message could not be deleted. Try again.

data.name: ProfileQrHelp
data.value: To add each other in person, both of you open "Add in person" and scan the code on the other's screen. To send your code through another messenger, send the text below or save the QR code as an image.

data.name: AddContactNoCodeInImage
data.value: No contact code was found in this image. Open a sharper picture of the whole QR code, or ask for the code as text.

data.name: InPersonIntro
data.value: Do this only while you are together. Each of you opens this page and scans the code on the other's screen. A code that someone sent you goes to "Add contact" instead, because it may have been swapped on the way.

data.name: InPersonAddedFormat
data.value: {0} is added, with the key checked by you. Now let {0} scan your code. Your apps connect when both of you have scanned and you are on the same network or both connected to Tor.

data.name: InPersonKeysAcceptedFormat
data.value: The new connection keys of {0} are accepted, with the key checked by you. Now let {0} scan your code. Your apps connect when both of you have scanned and you are on the same network or both connected to Tor.

data.name: InPersonAlreadyCheckedFormat
data.value: {0} is already a contact, and the key you scanned matches the one you have. It is now marked as checked by you.

data.name: InPersonConnectedFormat
data.value: {0} scanned your code too, and your apps are connected. The app checked their key, not who they are.

data.name: InPersonNotACode
data.value: This QR code is not a P2PMessenger contact code.

data.name: InPersonNoCamera
data.value: No camera was found on this device. Exchange codes as text, a file or a QR image instead.

data.name: InPersonCameraRefused
data.value: The app may not use the camera. Allow it in the system settings, or exchange codes as text, a file or a QR image instead.

data.name: InPersonCameraFailed
data.value: The camera could not be started. Close other apps that use it and try again, or exchange codes as text, a file or a QR image instead.

data.name: ScanHint
data.value: Point the camera at the QR code on their screen.

data.name: ConversationKeyNotComparedInPersonFormat
data.value: The key of {0} is marked as not compared. Compare fingerprints with {0} before you trust this contact.

data.name: BackgroundFirstRun
data.value: To keep receiving messages while the phone is idle, allow P2PMessenger to run in the background and to show notifications. You can change this later on the Background page.

data.name: BackgroundIntro
data.value: P2PMessenger keeps running while the screen is off, with a notification that stays while it runs, so that messages from your contacts reach this phone.

data.name: BackgroundBatteryExempt
data.value: Battery optimisation is off for P2PMessenger, so Android lets it run while the phone is idle.

data.name: BackgroundBatteryNotExempt
data.value: Battery optimisation is on for P2PMessenger: Android may delay messages while the phone is idle. P2PMessenger keeps working.

data.name: BackgroundBatteryRefused
data.value: Not allowed. Android may delay messages while the phone is idle; P2PMessenger keeps working, and you can allow it here later.

data.name: BackgroundNotificationsAllowed
data.value: Notifications are on: a new message shows who sent it while P2PMessenger is in the background.

data.name: BackgroundNotificationsOff
data.value: Notifications are off for P2PMessenger: you will not see new messages while it is in the background, and the notification that it is running is hidden.

data.name: BackgroundPreviewsHint
data.value: When this is off, a notification shows only who sent the message. The lock screen never shows the sender or the text.

data.name: BackgroundQuitWarning
data.value: It stops running in the background, and messages will not arrive on this phone until you open the app again. Waiting messages stay on this device.

data.name: BackgroundQuitFailed
data.value: P2PMessenger could not quit. Try again.

data.name: NotificationUnlockText
data.value: Open P2PMessenger and enter your passphrase to receive messages.

data.name: NotificationChannelLockScreen
data.value: New messages on the lock screen

data.name: BackgroundRestricted
data.value: Android does not let P2PMessenger run in the background, because its battery use is restricted: the app stops soon after you leave it, and messages arrive only while it is open. To change this, allow background use in the app's battery settings.

data.name: GroupItemJoining
data.value: Not joined yet: open it to see whom to add

data.name: GroupItemWaitingFormat
data.value: Waiting for {0} of {1} members to join

data.name: GroupItemListsDiffer
data.value: The member lists do not match

data.name: NewGroupIntro
data.value: Choose contacts who have all added each other. Each invited member joins once they have every other member as a contact. Nobody can write in the group until every member has joined, so that everyone sees the same member list.

data.name: NewGroupNoContacts
data.value: You have no contacts to invite yet. Only contacts whose first connection is complete can be invited.

data.name: NewGroupInvalidName
data.value: Enter a group name of up to 64 bytes (fewer letters in some alphabets) without control characters.

data.name: NewGroupTooManyFormat
data.value: A group can have at most {0} members, you included.

data.name: NewGroupNotAdded
data.value: A chosen contact is no longer an added contact. Choose again.

data.name: NewGroupFailed
data.value: The group could not be saved on this device. Try again.

data.name: GroupJoiningIntro
data.value: You have not joined this group yet. To join, add these members as contacts, in person or with codes sent through another channel, and compare fingerprints with them. Your app joins by itself once you have added them all.

data.name: GroupJoiningNone
data.value: You have every member as a contact. Your app joins as soon as each first connection is complete.

data.name: GroupWaitingFormat
data.value: Waiting for these members to join: {0}. Nobody can write in the group until every member has joined.

data.name: GroupListsDifferFormat
data.value: The member lists of this group do not match: {0} joined with a different list than yours. Nobody can write in this group; create a new one with the people you trust.

data.name: GroupNotCreatedYet
data.value: Not sent: you can write once every member has joined.

data.name: GroupTooLong
data.value: Not sent: the message is too long for a group.

data.name: GroupNotAGroup
data.value: Not sent: this group is no longer on this device.

data.name: GroupDeliveryWaitingExplanation
data.value: No other member's app has confirmed this message yet; it is sent again automatically to each member until their app does, and it may already have arrived.

data.name: GroupDeliveryReceivedExplanation
data.value: This many members' apps confirmed directly to this device that they have stored the message; it does not show whether anyone has read it. Other members may already have received it through another member, and this count updates when their app connects to yours. Because a member's app has it and can pass it on, it can no longer be deleted on its own.

data.name: GroupDeleteChatQuestionFormat
data.value: Delete the chat of {0}? Its messages are removed from this device, and your messages that are still waiting are no longer sent from it. You stay a member and keep receiving new messages. The members' apps keep their copies and can pass them on to other members.

data.name: GroupChatDeleted
data.value: The chat was deleted on this device only. You are still a member, and the members' apps still have their copies and can pass them on to other members.

data.name: GroupMessageDeleteQuestion
data.value: Delete this waiting message? This device will not send it again.

data.name: GroupMessageDeleted
data.value: The waiting message was deleted on this device and will not be sent again. If it reached a member's app before that app's confirmation came back, it stays there and that app can pass it on to other members.

data.name: GroupMessageNotDeletable
data.value: A member's app has already received the message, so it was not deleted.
